scope: The Panarion entire, held for heresy 51, the Alogi.
verified_loci: Panarion, the table of heresies: the Alogi, who receive neither the Gospel nor the Apocalypse of John — 'οἱ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον καὶ τὴν ἀποκάλυψιν Ἰωάννου μὴ δεχόμενοι' (written in NFC as 'οἱ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον καὶ τὴν ἀποκάλυψιν Ἰωάννου μὴ δεχόμενοι'; the seated TEI carries the oxia forms, so the locus is given in the text's own code points)
Panarion 51.3: the heresy that rejects the books of John — 'ἀποβάλλουσαν Ἰωάννου τὰς βίβλους'
why_seated: The dispute in which rejecting the book's reading meant rejecting its author: stratum 3.3.
